title: Unroll
intro: The traced windings, X-ray CT and ink layers in Unroll come from the Vesuvius Challenge open data, and every one of them reads straight from these URLs in your own tool, with no account and no download step.

sources.title: A traced winding (tifxyz), example PHerc0841 w00
sources.note: Every winding Unroll shows has a folder like this under SCROLL/segments/ in the open data; Unroll keeps only a decimated copy for the browser.

sources.title: Every segment of a scroll, example PHerc0841
sources.note: Each segment folder has mesh/ (tifxyz), surface-volumes/ (OME-Zarr layers) and, where published, ink-detection/.

sources.title: X-ray CT behind the CT view, PHerc0139 9.362 um
sources.note: Streamed from the open-data bucket, never copied here. Unroll opens any other scan with ?ctzarr=URL&ctum=VOXEL_UM.
